content: Capacitor 8 is current (iOS package v8.5.1 as of Sept 2026); adopts Swift Package Manager as default iOS dependency manager (CocoaPods still works for existing projects); requires Android Studio Otter 2025.2.1+. Capacitor wraps any vanilla JS/HTML/CSS web app in a native WebView shell for iOS and Android with near-1M weekly downloads, actively maintained by Ionic.
